subject: Admin activity ledger: manifest handshake, sampling matrix, and delivery options
messages:
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@novamed.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin activity ledger export options and sample manifest

Hi Logan / Kimberly,

We're preparing materials for our SOC 2 auditor and need a clear description of what Redwood can deliver for admin activity (operator) logs and how you package evidence. Specifically we need:
- A short inventory of fields you log for admin/operator actions (examples requested)
- Retention default and any configurable retention tiers (we're most interested in 90/180/365 day windows)
- Export formats you support (CSV/JSON/ndjson), whether manifests/checksums are provided, and signing options (HMAC / PGP)
- Delivery mechanisms (S3 presigned, SFTP, secure share, direct transfer) and cross-region constraints
- Redaction approach for PII in exports and whether you can provide an attested, sampled export (auditor often requests a stratified sample plus a full-manifest hash)

If you can include a one-page sample manifest and an example line from an export it would help the auditor scope the ask. Deadline: our auditor wants a preview by next Tuesday (2026-11-23).

Thanks,
Jane Miller
Senior IT Audit Manager
Novamed Health
[audit@novamed.com]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity ledger export options and sample manifest

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below, plus I'll attach an example manifest and one-row export sample. Kimberly and Karthik are looped in for regional / retention constraints.

What we log (admin/operator events) — representative fields: 
- event_time (ISO8601)
- actor_id (internal user id / service principal)
- actor_email (redacted on request)
- action (verb, e.g., "vm.start", "grant_role", "model-deploy")
- target_resource (resource id / tenant id)
- request_id / trace_id
- source_ip (CIDR / obfuscated on request)
- user_agent
- change_summary (short JSON blob or text)
- request_payload_sha256 (opaque hash of payload)
- result_status (success/fail + error code)
- session_id / ephemeral_key_id

Retention & tiers: 
- Hosted default: 90 days for full ephemeral operator actions, 365 days for privileged-role change events (configurable on Dedicated/Private plans).
- We offer an extended retention add-on (2–7 years) for enterprise customers with a committed contract.

Export formats & manifests: 
- Formats: ndjson (recommended), gzipped CSV, or compressed JSON lines.
- Manifest: CSV manifest listing file name, object size, sha256 checksum, HMAC-SHA256 (optional) and signed timestamp (ISO).
- Signing options: HMAC-SHA256 using a shared key you provide, or an RSA signature with a timestamped certificate we provide for the export session.

Delivery options: 
- S3 presigned PUT (single-use read URL), S3 Access (customer-bucket replication), SFTP push, or secure HTTP pull.
- Cross-region: exports are produced in the region where the customer's workspace is pinned; cross-region replication is supported but requires an account-level replication policy (adds ~24–48 hrs).

PII / redaction & sampling: 
- Redaction: we can redact actor_email and truncate source_ip at /24, or provide a parallel redacted export. PII fields in change_summary can be masked with configurable rules.
- Sampling: two modes — stratified (tenant/time window/actor) and targeted (specific actors/resources). We typically provide a stratified 1% sample plus a focused slice for the auditor's requested time range.

Timeline: we can produce a 1% stratified sample + manifest within 3 business days; a full export with manifest (and optional HMAC signing) typically takes 5–7 business days depending on window size and region.

Attached: example-manifest.csv (small), one-row-sample.ndjson (single event).

If you'd like a signed attestation (sealed manifest with timestamp and verifier URL) we can produce that via our Export Attestation service — will add 1 business day.

Next steps: please confirm preferred delivery method (S3 presigned / SFTP) and whether you need HMAC or RSA signing. Also confirm the auditor's preferred sample strategy (stratified vs targeted).

Best,
Logan Wright
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@novamed.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity ledger export options and sample manifest

Jane — a few operational notes to supplement Logan's answers: 

1) Sampling matrix guidance: 
- We recommend a stratified sample covering: 3 evenly spaced days per quarter within the requested window, plus 100% of privilege-escalation events in that same window. That gives auditors both breadth and the high-risk slices.
- If the auditor wants tenant-specific proof, we can do a targeted export for that tenant's tenant_id with full fidelity.

2) Redaction and chain-of-custody: 
- Redaction is deterministic (same input -> same masked output) so auditors can verify that the manifest hash maps to the redacted files.
- Chain-of-custody: we provide a signed PDF that includes export parameters, actor that initiated the export, HMAC key id (if used), and an export run timestamp. The PDF is timestamped and notarized by our export attestation service.

3) Transport & integrity: 
- We publish a manifest CSV with file-level SHA256 and a run-level HMAC-SHA256. If the auditor requests RSA signatures instead we can provide a detached signature file.
- For S3 transfers we can optionally push directly to your bucket (requires cross-account role setup) which reduces handling steps.

4) Compliance notes: 
- For SOC 2, auditors typically accept our attested manifest + chain-of-custody PDF. For SIG/CAIQ evidence requests we can map the fields to control IDs and provide a traceability table.

Attachments: chain-of-custody-instructions.pdf (short checklist), export-policy-s3.txt (example cross-account role policy).

If Novamed confirms the delivery method and whether PII should be redacted in the sample, we'll schedule the sample run for Monday and target delivery by Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@novamed.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity ledger export options and sample manifest

Logan / Kimberly — this is perfect, thank you. Novamed prefers:
- Delivery: S3 presigned read URLs for the sample (auditor prefers not to open an account role for samples)
- Signing: HMAC-SHA256 (we will share a one-time HMAC key via your secure upload form)
- Redaction: please redact actor_email and mask IPs to /24
- Sample: stratified 1% + all privilege-escalation events for the past 90 days

Please proceed with the sample run and send the manifest + chain-of-custody PDF when ready. We expect the auditor to review the sample and provide any follow-ups by Friday next week.

Also: please paste a HubSpot link to the record when you send the artifacts so I can attach them to the SOC 2 workpaper.

Thanks again — Jane
---
